items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Louis Domaine's sitting in front of the bass drum.

ctx.x: He has his bass there on that end.
Louis Domaine's sitting in front of the bass drum. Who's the bass drum player?

Yeah. That's Peter Rayfield. Oh, I don't know him. Peter Rayfield, yeah. That's Peter Rayfield. And this is what you call, I'm trying to think of his name, Honest Tapania. Oh yeah, Tapania. Oh yeah, that's how that's. That's Tapania, yeah. I was a good drummer also. You got kind of stout there. Yeah, him and Happy was as honest. At one time, I don't think no greater than them two.
